thought.text: The UI SPA fallback checks the `accept` header — wget sends `*/*`. Let me test with a browser-like Accept header.

reasoning_content: The UI is served with a fallback to index.html for GET requests that aren't found. It checks the `accept` header. `wget` probably sends `Accept: */*` or an Accept header that doesn't match HTML, and that's why the 404 came back. Let me check the condition in the notFoundHandler and test with a browser-like Accept header.

action.command: echo "=== with browser Accept header ==="; curl -sS -H "Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml" -o /tmp/maildev_ui.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} | %{size_download} bytes\n" http://localhost:1080/; grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/maildev_ui.html 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo "=== SPA fallback route ==="; curl -sS -H "Accept: text/html" -o /dev/null -w "/home -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:1080/home; echo "=== API via host :1080 ==="; curl -sS http://localhost:1080/api/email/summary | head -c 200
